topic: Prompt of the week: turn a long report into a one-page brief (Claude Opus 5.5)
post:
AI models can now read a stack of documents at once. 📚
Here's the prompt I'd use to actually put that to work.

This week Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5:

⚡ Over 30% faster output than Opus 5
💰 About 40% cheaper to run on typical workloads
📏 A 1-million-token context window (roughly several long books' worth of text)

Bigger memory only helps if you ask the right question.
So here's my prompt of the week 👇

"You are my chief of staff. Read the attached report.
Give me:
1. The 5 points that matter most, in plain English
2. Any numbers or claims I should double-check
3. Risks or open questions
4. 3 decisions I need to make, with a recommendation for each
Keep it to one page."

Why it matters:
Most of us don't need AI to write more. We need it to help us read less and decide faster.

Practical takeaway:
Try it on the longest document in your inbox this week. Then compare its summary with what you'd have written. Always verify the numbers.

What's the longest document you'd hand to AI first? 👇

Follow for daily AI news.
